observations: Rectangular coffee table with a white-painted base.
The top surface features a pink, beige, and white marble-effect pattern.
The base contains one drawer with a decorative gold-colored handle and one open shelf.
The table stands on four short, molded feet.
A watermark 'VINTAGE OAK POSTED ON JIJI' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The white paint hides the wood grain; this appearance is more common for MDF or particle board than solid oak.
The marble pattern could be a laminate, real stone, or a print under glass; the photo does not show the edge clearly enough to confirm glass.
Origin and 'exquisite' quality cannot be determined from a single front-facing photo.

risks.risk: The body may be made of MDF or particle board rather than solid oak.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside or an unpainted interior edge of the drawer.

risks.risk: The top may be a marble-effect laminate or sticker rather than tempered glass.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the edge of the table top to see the material layers.

risks.risk: The drawer may be stuck or have broken runners.
risks.proof: A video showing the drawer being opened and closed.

risks.risk: There may be scratches, chips, or water damage on the hidden sides or back.
risks.proof: Photos of the back and both side panels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having minor cosmetic damage.

proof_requests: Photo of the underside of the table to verify the wood type.
Close-up photo of the edge of the top surface to confirm if it is glass.
Video of the drawer opening and closing.
Photos of the back and sides of the table.
response.reason: The item is a standard modern coffee table. Although the material claims (oak and glass) are unverified, it can be priced at the worst-case scenario for its type (engineered wood with a laminate top).
